name: Forever Virgin Simulator
source:
A post-ironic, meta-narrative, ultra-short game that touches on the problems of modern relationships.

You play as a virgin who really wants to get rid of that status.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4630060/]Steam[/url]]
